description: 기후에너지환경부 한강홍수통제소_홍수예보_표준유역 MAPLE 강수량 [flood] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 기후에너지환경부 한강홍수통제소. 한강홍수통제소에서 기상청으로부터 수집한 MAPLE 데이터를 기반으로 예측한 표준유역별 MAPLE 강우량 데이터입니다. MAPLE은 기상청에서 운영하는 초단기 레이더 강수량 예측 모델로, 국지성 집중호우 등 기상 변화에 신속하게 대응하기 위해 개발되었습니다. 대권역명,표준유역명,년월일시분,우량,예측우량으로... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 기후에너지환경부 한강홍수통제소. Its tags are 홍수, 강우량, 예보, MAPLE, 표준유역. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-12-23 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
